Omkar Kulkarni
Senior Financial Analyst | Thane West
omkar.kulkarni575@example.com | +91 9657639416

Finance professional with a strong track record in budgeting, forecasting and financial planning across e-commerce and retail sectors. Skilled at building models and dashboards that drive operational decisions and cost optimization. Seeking to contribute analytical rigor and process improvements while transitioning roles with a 90 days notice period.

Experience

Swiggy — Feb 2024 - Present
Senior Financial Analyst
- Built driver-level and city-level financial models using Microsoft Excel to forecast quarterly contribution margins; model improvements reduced forecast variance from 12% to 4% within two quarters (FP&A, Financial Modelling).
- Led monthly budgeting cycle for three verticals, producing detailed budget packages and scenario analyses that identified INR 18M in potential savings (Budgeting, FP&A).
- Automated recurring reporting with Excel macros and template standardization, cutting report preparation time by 45% and enabling faster executive decision-making (Microsoft Excel, FP&A).
- Collaborated with operations and product teams on pricing experiments, creating break-even models that informed two pricing changes yielding a 6% uplift in unit economics (Financial Modelling, Budgeting).

Quanta Retail — Apr 2018 - Jan 2024
FP&A Manager
- Designed and maintained multi-subsidiary financial models for P&L, cash flow and balance sheet projections using Financial Modelling techniques; supported monthly close and management review cycles (Financial Modelling, FP&A).
- Implemented SAP FICO-centered reporting templates and integrations that shortened month-end reconciliation time by 30% and improved ledger accuracy (SAP FICO, Microsoft Excel).
- Led annual budgeting and quarterly reforecasting across merchandising and supply chain functions, aligning spend to strategic priorities and reducing SG&A run-rate by 8% over 12 months (Budgeting, FP&A).
- Adopted Agile workstreams for cross-functional FP&A projects, running two-week sprints for forecast updates and delivering prioritized analytics to stakeholders on a biweekly cadence (Agile, FP&A).

Projects
- Dynamic Discount Impact Model: Developed an Excel-driven model to simulate promotional discount scenarios and their impact on margin and inventory days; model used by merchandising to set promotion thresholds (Financial Modelling, Microsoft Excel).
- SAP FICO Reporting Templates: Created standardized report packs and reconciliation checklists in SAP FICO that were rolled out across three business units, improving data consistency and audit readiness (SAP FICO).
